quote: Users can harness LLM-backed AI assistants for various subjective everyday tasks, which we define as self-contained activities that are straightforward for a user to describe to an AI assistant and involve the (anthropomorphized) AI assistant making some decision in completing the task.
Large language models (LLMs), such as OpenAI's GPT models and Meta's Llama models, generate or predict natural language based on internet-scale training data.
outputs: Generated responses to prompts for everyday tasks, such as summarizing articles, suggesting recipes, grouping students, writing code, and editing text

The paper evaluates LLM-generated outputs across 30 everyday tasks involving decision-making with implicit values, such as copyediting emails, selecting travel plans, suggesting recipes, and writing code.

quote: We recruited 100 crowdworkers on the Prolific platform to complete the same 30 tasks... Participants completed all 30 tasks (plus two attention checks) in randomized order.
We then had 100 crowdworkers on the Prolific platform complete the same 30 tasks. We recruited participants age 18+ who were located in the United States and had a 95%+ approval rating on Prolific.
guideline: Participants completed all 30 tasks (plus two attention checks) in randomized order, and their responses were compared to the LLM outputs to assess alignment of implicit values.
